2512.21329.title: Your Reasoning Benchmark May Not Test Reasoning: Revealing Perception Bottleneck in Abstract Reasoning Benchmarks
2512.21329.verdict: CLOSEST NEIGHBOUR, MISSED BY THE FIRST TWO PASSES. Challenges the reasoning-deficit interpretation of the ARC gap and hypothesises it arises primarily from limitations in VISUAL PERCEPTION, verified with a two-stage pipeline explicitly separating perception from reasoning. WE MUST STOP CLAIMING perception-as-bottleneck as a finding. OUR DELTA, and it is real: their perception stage converts each image to a natural-language description WITH A MODEL, so their separation is model-mediated and inherits the describer's errors. Ours is a DETERMINISTIC GEOMETRIC inversion with a closed-form ground truth, giving a numeric ceiling rather than a two-stage comparison.

2504.15280.title: Seeing from Another Perspective: Evaluating Multi-View Understanding in MLLMs
2504.15280.verdict: ADJACENT — All-Angles Bench, 2100+ annotated multi-view QA pairs over 90 real scenes, testing multi-view geometric consistency and cross-view correspondence. Establishes that multi-view correspondence is a known MLLM weakness, which SUPPORTS our premise. Not occupied: real scenes with human annotation, no closed-form ceiling, and no crystallography.

2003.14328.title: CRYSPNet: Crystal Structure Predictions via Neural Network
2003.14328.input: chemical composition ONLY (aggregated properties of the constituent elements)
2003.14328.bearing_on_us: OPPOSITE input to our random-forest control, which reads the CELL METRIC (19 lattice features) and never sees composition. Does NOT occupy row B. Cited instead as the reason our composition-EXCLUSION split matters: it blocks the CRYSPNet route.

2411.00803.title: Designing a Dataset for Convolutional Neural Networks to Predict Space Groups Consistent with Extinction Laws
2411.00803.input: 1D powder patterns COMPUTED FROM lattice parameters and extinction laws
2411.00803.reported: accuracy matching the theoretical maximums calculated based on Extinction Laws
2411.00803.bearing_on_us: Its ceiling is ANALYTIC (derivable in closed form for a synthetic pattern with a known generative process); ours is EMPIRICAL (a reconstruction on actual renders whose achievable value nobody can write down in advance). Same goal by a route unavailable to us.

2512.21329.title: Your Reasoning Benchmark May Not Test Reasoning: Revealing Perception Bottleneck in Abstract Reasoning Benchmarks
2512.21329.method: two-stage pipeline explicitly separating perception from reasoning: each image is independently converted to a natural-language description, then a model induces and applies rules from those descriptions
2512.21329.establishes: the ARC / ARC-AGI gap arises primarily from limitations in VISUAL PERCEPTION, not deficient machine reasoning
2512.21329.bearing_on_us: 'The perception bottleneck' is PUBLISHED. We must stop presenting it as a finding. Our delta: their perception stage is MODEL-MEDIATED and inherits the describer's errors; ours is a DETERMINISTIC GEOMETRIC inversion against a closed-form ground truth, yielding a NUMERIC CEILING rather than a two-stage contrast.

2603.16253.title: Grounding the Score: Explicit Visual Premise Verification for Reliable Vision-Language Process Reward Models
2603.16253.establishes: a verifier's low score may reflect a reasoning mistake OR the verifier's own misperception; that entanglement produces systematic false positives and negatives
2603.16253.bearing_on_us: The ENTANGLEMENT problem is published — cite as motivation, do not present as an observation. Unoccupied: a DETERMINISTIC GEOMETRIC checker that cannot misperceive because it reads coordinates, not pixels.

2506.12776.establishes: frames the same 'Resolution Dilemma' and notes existing benchmarks neglect resolution as a factor
